title: Scalar source and class coherence before coefficients
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring in Type(u+1), W and S schemes in universe u, k:W→S a scheme morphism, G an etale Λ-module sheaf on W, q a natural number, U an object of S.Etale, A and B objects of Over(W), f:A→B a morphism, and z an element of (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G q U)(B). With the source factors of def-sbc-raw-scalar-source-factors and the prefix of def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-source-prefix, the scalar source factor at A followed by the derived forgotten module source factor and the derived forgotten module inverse image of z equals rawModuleScalarSourcePrefix followed by the inverse derived scalar pullback comparison at the shifted B coefficient. The canonical derived comparison is the composite defined in the module of lem-sbc-raw-scalar-coefficient-unshifted. No module coefficient factor or scalar coefficient factor is attached.

source.place: Tags 03D7 and 03Q8; source and class steps of lem-sbc-raw-module-abelian-hom-source-formula

proof.text: Apply the proved scalar sheaf-composition equation to the free represented module sheaf at f.left and the two composite arrows to S. Naturality of upperStarComp at freeMap and the elementary sheaf_source_attach composition calculation attach the free abelian generator. Apply the proved plus_single_source_square_core in degree zero. Its derived comparison is definitionally the existing canonical derivedPullbackIso from RawModuleScalarCoefficientUnshifted. No concrete SourceSquare-module import or comparison-interface change is used.

Use the elementary source_class_attach naturality calculation: postcompose the source square with the derived forgotten module inverse image of the actual raw class, apply naturality of the inverse derived comparison at that class, and combine the abelian maps using Functor.map_comp and associativity. The resulting source prefix and coefficient object agree definitionally with the unchanged statement. This applies to zero classes, degree zero, identity morphisms, and zero or empty objects without an additional hypothesis.
